title: Nonlinear Frequency Translation in Micromachined Rb Vapor Cells
summary: The exceptional nonlinearity of alkali-metal vapors enables highly efficient nonlinear optical processes even at relatively low optical intensities. However, such processes have traditionally relied on centimeter-scale vapor cells. Here, we utilize a versatile chip-scale Rb vapor platform to generate coherent blue and mid-IR light in continuous-wave mode by means of resonant four-wave mixing. Optimized optical overlap with the atomic medium enables blue light generation of $\sim$20 $μ$W over a very short interaction length, while maintaining a directly measured linewidth of $\sim$1 MHz,…
